title: On the Possibilities of Defining Infinite Oriented Matroids
summary: Is it possible to define cryptomorphic axiom systems for infinite oriented matroids by lifting some of the axiom systems for finite oriented matroids to the infinite setting while not losing duality in the process? We show that the answer to this question is a twofold "no". First, lifting the circuit axioms neither preserves duality nor inheritance of strong circuit elimination in minors.
